receiptManager.policy: Das Fenster darf allgemein nur gelesen und geschlossen werden. Navigation, Lesen, kataloggebundenes Befuellen, dateihashgebundener Belegimport, exakt dialoggebundene Kategorie-/Personenzuordnung, zielseitig gebundenes Verknuepfen/Entknuepfen und das explizit bestaetigte Loeschen sind ausschliesslich ueber die spezialisierten sse_receipt_manager_* Operationen erlaubt. Freie Selektoren, freies Verknuepfen/Entknuepfen, ungebundenes Uebernehmen und Popup-Aktionen bleiben gesperrt.

vastAssignment.policy: Read and map with the sse_vast_* tools. Applying mapped data requires sse_vast_apply with the complete plan, mapping fingerprint, exact case/hash and explicit acknowledgement; it is never implied by changing a mapping.

kostenkategorie_13b.bindingPolicy: Bind the repeated cost-category §13b subpage by heading, first Summe occurrence and the exact grpEmpf13b automation-ID section; reject a material-page grp13bErwerb first table.

columns.reason: SSE repeats this §13b table below multiple cost categories. The exact profiled value may already be selected; otherwise only a popup-bound SelectionItem is allowed.

sonstige_leistung_eu.bindingPolicy: Prefer automationIdSection from the selected summary region; if the snapshot does not expose it, fail closed by heading, sumLabel, sumOccurrence and column index.

columns.reason: Qt exposes this semantic selector as DataItem. Only an exact, popup-bound SelectionItem is allowed; ValuePattern text alone is never a commit proof.
